character: Traditional alpine village with authentic charm, wooden chalets, and working farms. One of the few true working farming villages in a major ski area. 40+ restaurants. Bars, shops, and a lively, younger apres scene. Linked to Portes du Soleil. Cheese shops.
dining: 40+ restaurants — La Marmite, L'Atelier, Le Vieux Châtel. Local cheese (Abondance). Mountain dining. Farm restaurants.
shopping: Supermarket (Carrefour Montagne), bakery, cheese shops (Abondance AOP), sports rental, clothing. Local produce.
apres_scene: Le Couttet (nightclub). Le Swiss. Bar Le Comptoir. Lively, young scene. Music venues.
activities_nearby: Super-Châtel high-altitude satellite. Aquariaz (Avoriaz). Dogsledding. Snowshoeing. Hiking. Paragliding. 650km PDS.
